机制概述: Hayden has 7 double-sided Fury/Control Counters which she can use to enhance her attacks. Most of her cards give abilities by spending a group of Counters, flipping them over to their opposite side.

效果.效果: Setup: Gain 2 Fury and 2 Control. Then, gain your choice of 1 Fury or 1 Control. Trash all remaining Fury/Control.
If you deplete a Fury or Control, also flip it over to its opposite side. (Converting Fury to Control or vice versa.)
Recycle: Regain all Fury/Control. They remain on their current side.
